registries.name: Official MCP Registry
registries.registration_process: GitHub Actions + mcp-publisher using GitHub OIDC

registries.name: Global A2A Registry
registries.registration_process: Submit the public AgentSite URL; the registry auto-discovers /.well-known/agent-card.json. No account is required for initial listing.
registries.blocking_reason: Current tool access cannot submit the external web form, so no registration is claimed.

registries.name: Glama MCP Directory
registries.registration_process: Submit the public GitHub repository or remote MCP connector. Glama also indexes MCP ecosystem sources.

registries.name: Smithery
registries.registration_process: Submit the publicly reachable remote MCP endpoint or supported repository package.

registries.name: mcp.so
registries.registration_process: Submit the public repository and MCP metadata; some entries are also discovered from public ecosystem sources.

registries.name: PulseMCP
registries.registration_process: Public MCP servers may be indexed from public repositories and ecosystem registries.
